'''Passi Kohlemainen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 King Con Sunday tournament]] on 20 February 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations flip-and-drain]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base with asteroids]], according to Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d267">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-febd267/ king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-feb], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 20 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-febd267/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
